notes.title: Help Us Win A Patch Award!
notes.notes:
[p]Gather round, Geckos! 🦎

We're honoured to announce that we've been nominated for a Patch Award! 

[url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSejX8q0QXPgHSy_JScUXjpc_Vo-Q8HWliJ6fbd0MVG4Yz3klQ/viewform?pli=1" style="button"]Vote by September 25th here so we can win the "Anticipated Gem" category. [/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955380/eedd750d43dc1a9d4ca67b8fc1187e6e313a92c0.jpg"][/img]

A huge thank you to Patch Magazine, and a congratulations to all other nominees! Let's make 2025 more gecko-filled and thank you for helping us get there. 

Don't forget, our WWF-UK donation drive is still live! [url="https://tiltify.com/@super-rare-originals/gecko-gods-fundraiser-for-wwf-uk?origin=dashboard"]Please if you can, donate here too [/url]so that we can help geckos and wildlife everywhere, before this drive ends on October 2nd.

As always, till next time! 

- The Gecko Gods team. 💚
 









[/p]

notes.title: Gecko Gods - Demo Patch
notes.notes: [h2]Hey Geckos! 🦎[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve been absolutely blown away by the love and support you’ve shown during Steam’s June Next Fest. It’s been an incredible experience seeing so many of you explore our world for the very first time - thank you![/p][p]We’ve been carefully listening to your feedback, and we’ve just pushed a [b]hotfix patch[/b] to smooth out some rough edges and improve your experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]toggle sprint[/b] option in the Accessibility settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]unlock mouse cursor[/b] option in Accessibility (MHOOK compatibility)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]gap in water[/b] in the platforming section[/p][/*][*][p][b]Objectives now clear[/b] correctly when starting a new game[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed [b]audio stuttering[/b] issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]audio volume bugs[/b] when pausing/unpausing[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected [b]typos[/b] in the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Patched several [b]out-of-bounds exploits[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with [b]camera zooming in too much[/b] in the Cathedral[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]auto-pickup range[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re continuing to watch for, and action, your feedback and really appreciate everyone who’s taken the time to report bugs, suggest features, or just say kind things. It means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p]- Gecko Gods Team 💚[/p][p][/p][p]Please join our discord using the link below, where you can share any feedback, report bugs, or interact with our awesome community![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/gJ5DMjzeHJ"]Gecko Gods Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: After years of radio silence, Gecko Gods has finally announced a release window and published a demo
notes.notes: Gecko Gods has released its first demo as part of the Wholesome Direct alongside showcasing a brand new trailer for the reptile adventure, and as someone who has kept an eye on the development of this game since 2021 I could not be more thrilled... Read more.

notes.title: The Gecko Gods - Development Update 🦎
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Geckos![/h2]
I want to thank you all for your patience and support throughout development. We know things have been quiet on our end, rest assured, we’ve been working hard behind the scenes to craft a game we’re truly proud of, and we hope you will love, even if it has taken longer than we originally planned

We have secured some additional funding and brought on two experienced developers to help us get the game over the finish line

I would like to thank everyone who has shown so much love and support for our project. We have some exciting announcements coming in the next few months, so stay tuned!

We look forward to bringing you The Gecko Gods later this year
[h3]- Louis Waloschek, Game Director[/h3]
